label: fallback never written: a committed lane with no body still strands its commit
existing body ignored: the worker's body is replaced by a generated fallback
no-commit guard dropped: a lane that committed nothing writes a hand-off body
partial label lost: the fallback no longer says it is a partial hand-off
old: Partial: the worker did not write
new: Draft: the worker did not write

label: claim waiver lost: the partial body no longer clears the claim seam it must pass
old: Claim check: none: the worker did not write a claim before it exited (partial hand-off).
new: none: the worker did not write a claim before it exited (partial hand-off).

label: helper call dropped: lane.sh reaches the body seams with no body at all
swap dropped: the lane writes the fallback but keeps reading the missing worker body
suite unwired: the gate no longer runs the partial hand-off proof
